traceTitle: auth/DoA/doa-agent-access.spec.ts:34 › Delegated Organisation - Agent Visibility › Carol Clark (agent) submits for Plant Org 1 → Carol Clark (agent) can see it on her dashboard
crossTypeNote: Cross-type evidence observed with a CHED-PP Plant-organisation fixture. CHED-P is a POAO application; this finding applies only the rendered delegated-authority mechanism and does not infer any POAO-specific journey detail.
journeySummary: Carol Clark selects IPAFFS Plant Organisation 1, submits a CHED-PP notification for it, then finds the client-owned Trade Partner notification on her own agent dashboard with view, copy and amend controls.

delegatedAgentPagesAndControls.page: Which company is this notification for

observations.verbatim: IPAFFS Plant Organisation 1 KAINOS SOFTWARE LTD, 4-6 UPPER CRESCENT BELFAST BT7 1NT
observations.accessibleName: IPAFFS Plant Organisation 1 KAINOS SOFTWARE LTD, 4-6 UPPER CRESCENT BELFAST BT7 1NT
observations.meaning: The represented client organisation is selected and shown checked.

observations.verbatim: CHED status: New; Trade Partner; Consignee: IPAFFS Plant Organisation 1
observations.meaning: Carol's dashboard shows the notification created for the represented client.

observations.verbatim: View details; Copy as new; Amend
observations.accessibleName: View details / Copy as new / Amend
observations.meaning: The submitting agent retains access to the submitted delegated notification.

visibilityOwnershipRules.rule: The agent who submits for a represented organisation can still find the submitted notification on their own dashboard.
Agent visibility does not change the client ownership marker: the card remains Trade Partner and names Plant Organisation 1 as consignee.

limitations: This trace creates CHED-PP with a Plant organisation and supplies no POAO-specific rendered detail.
This trace demonstrates the submitting agent's visibility after submission; it does not test another member of the agent's own agency or draft visibility.
